APPROVE
The method now just dispatches to two helpers, well under the threshold. The split keeps the same evaluation order and short-circuiting (the added `k > 0` is always true because `k ≥ body.Start + 1`), and it uses only existing types and APIs, so it should build with warnings as errors. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build the project or run the tests.
